issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() to return a double, but the solution implementation defines getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning an int. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and leads to a different calculation (integer division vs. floating-point division).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML by changing the method signature to return double and perform floating-point division. For example: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); } Also update the template method signature/comments to indicate a double return type so students implement the correct type.
